lines.t: Pine Rivers Koala Care Association Inc

We are partnering with Bush Care groups to replace exotic weeds with local natives to enhance the koala corridor so koalas have access to fodder trees. We will be planting out a variety of native grasses, shrubs and trees to support biodiversity whilst replenishing and building the stock of available koala-friendly habitat trees.
Rob Akers reserve at Strathpine (meeting point in the car park)
Tools will be supplied but please bring any you would like to use, wear closed in shoes, long pants, shirt and a hat, bring a water bottle, snacks, and gloves.
